verdict.rationale: No first-party document in the pack names unattended access or describes configuring host credentials in advance. A hands-on community report describes using TeamViewer to remotely log into an otherwise unattended PC. Discussions of saved client-side passwords and the docs on admin-managed devices loosely imply that pre-configured access exists. Security criticism of how those stored credentials are kept does not contradict the capability, so it is not treated as a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of unattended-access setup, documented pre-configured host password or account-assignment flow, and confirmation that no host-side acceptance is needed.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept
